title: Plotting Left-Censored Data
text: environmental laboratory data, analytical results frequently “left-censored.” occurs target compound detected laboratory’s Method Detection Limit (MDL). non-detects (often reported “ND” flagged “U” qualifier) pose visualization challenge. common standard plot non-detects MDL fraction MDL (e.g., 1/2 MDL) using distinct symbology. ggsuppress package can handle row--row dynamically. Let’s look built-groundwater dataset see .
code: library(ggsuppress) library(ggplot2)  # View the structure of the data head(groundwater[10:20,]) #>         Sample_ID Location_ID Sample_Date Parameter  Result Numeric_Result #> 10 GW-2021Q1-MW-4        MW-4  2021-03-02   Cadmium  0.0003        0.00030 #> 11 GW-2021Q1-MW-4        MW-4  2021-01-27   Arsenic 0.00274        0.00274 #> 12 GW-2021Q1-MW-4        MW-4  2021-01-14      Lead  0.0006        0.00060 #> 13 GW-2021Q1-MW-5        MW-5  2021-02-27   Cadmium   7e-05        0.00007 #> 14 GW-2021Q1-MW-5        MW-5  2021-02-16   Arsenic      ND             NA #> 15 GW-2021Q1-MW-5        MW-5  2021-02-04      Lead      ND             NA #>    Units Qualifier   MDL    RL    Method #> 10  mg/L              NA    NA EPA 200.8 #> 11  mg/L              NA    NA EPA 200.8 #> 12  mg/L              NA    NA EPA 200.8 #> 13  mg/L         J 5e-05 2e-04 EPA 200.8 #> 14  mg/L         U 2e-04 1e-03 EPA 200.8 #> 15  mg/L         U 1e-04 5e-04 EPA 200.8

title: Plotting Left-Censored Data
text: Notice groundwater dataset contains character Result column (includes “ND” strings) Numeric_Result column. Important: ggsuppress requires numeric y aesthetic. user’s responsibility coerce character results numeric columns prior plotting. Numeric_Result column, “ND” strings converted NA.

title: Plotting Left-Censored Data
text: plot non-detects 1/2 specific MDL, map MDL column threshold proxy aesthetics directly inside geom_point_suppressed() function. also must set suppress_na = TRUE engine knows catch NA values apply proxy math .
code: ggplot(groundwater, aes(x = Sample_Date, y = Numeric_Result, color = Parameter)) +      geom_point_suppressed(     # Dynamically apply the MDL for each specific row     aes(threshold = MDL, proxy = MDL / 2),      suppress_na = TRUE,      size = 3,      stroke = 1.2   ) +   # Adjust legend labels for detection status   scale_shape_suppress(     name = 'Detection Status',     labels = c(`FALSE` = "Detected", `TRUE` = "Non-detect (1/2 MDL)")   ) +   theme_minimal() +   labs(     title = "Groundwater Monitoring Results",     subtitle = "Non-detects plotted at 1/2 MDL",     x = "Date",     y = "Concentration (mg/L)"   )

title: Plotting Left-Censored Data
text: different chemicals vastly different scales MDLs, usually best practice facet data. Notice ggsuppress handles dynamic MDLs across different facets, safely ignores rows valid detect measured MDL column left blank (NA).
code: ggplot(groundwater, aes(x = Sample_Date, y = Numeric_Result, color = Parameter)) +      geom_point_suppressed(     aes(threshold = MDL, proxy = MDL / 2),      suppress_na = TRUE,      size = 3,      stroke = 1.2   ) +      # Standard scale styling   scale_color_manual(     values = c("Arsenic" = "navy", "Cadmium" = "darkorange", "Lead" = "forestgreen")   ) +   # Adjust legend labels for detection status   scale_shape_suppress(     name = 'Detection Status',     labels = c(`FALSE` = "Detected", `TRUE` = "Non-detect (1/2 MDL)")   )  +      # Facet by parameter, allowing the y-axis scales to adjust freely   facet_wrap(~Parameter, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +      theme_bw() +   theme(legend.position = "bottom") +   labs(     title = "Groundwater Monitoring by Parameter",     x = "Sample Date",     y = "Concentration (mg/L)"   )

title: Small Number Suppression
text: public health informatics, often necessary employ small-number suppression protect patient privacy prevent misinterpretation unstable rates. common health data reporting threshold may suppress case counts less 11, example. ggsuppress package provides custom ggplot2 geometries automatically apply suppression rules, plot suppressed data proxy value (like 0), uniquely symbolize suppressed points. Let’s load necessary packages explore built-overdoses dataset.
code: library(ggsuppress) library(ggplot2)  # The overdoses dataset contains monthly counts for Salt Lake and Utah counties head(overdoses) #> # A tibble: 6 × 3 #>   county    month_date count #>   <chr>     <date>     <int> #> 1 Salt Lake 2021-01-01    14 #> 2 Salt Lake 2021-02-01    13 #> 3 Salt Lake 2021-03-01     9 #> 4 Salt Lake 2021-04-01    10 #> 5 Salt Lake 2021-05-01    13 #> 6 Salt Lake 2021-06-01    11

title: Small Number Suppression
text: plot data automatic suppression, simply swap standard ggplot2 geometries ggsuppress equivalents: geom_line_suppressed() geom_point_suppressed(). also use scale_shape_suppress() automatically generate hollow points values fell threshold (11).
code: ggplot(overdoses, aes(x = month_date, y = count, color = county)) +   # Draw the lines - ggplot will automatically group them by county   geom_line_suppressed(linewidth = 1) +      # Draw the points - they will automatically change shape based on suppression   geom_point_suppressed(size = 3, stroke = 1.2) +      # Standard color mapping   scale_color_manual(     name = "County",     values = c("Salt Lake" = "navy", "Utah" = "darkorange")   ) +      # Custom ggsuppress scale for hollow/solid shapes   scale_shape_suppress() +      theme_minimal() +   labs(     title = "Monthly Overdoses by County",      x = "Date",      y = "Reported Cases"   )

what: Customizing the Threshold and Proxy Value
title: Small Number Suppression
text: producing report requires different suppression rule, < 5? perhaps want plot suppressed values x-axis (e.g., -2) don’t overlap true zero counts? can easily adjust threshold proxy_value parameters inside geom functions.
code: ggplot(overdoses, aes(x = month_date, y = count, color = county)) +      geom_line_suppressed(     threshold = 5,      proxy_value = -2,      linewidth = 1   ) +      geom_point_suppressed(     threshold = 5,      proxy_value = -2,      size = 3,      stroke = 1.2   ) +      scale_color_manual(values = c("Salt Lake" = "navy", "Utah" = "darkorange")) +   scale_shape_suppress() +   theme_minimal() +   labs(     title = "Custom Suppression Rules",     subtitle = "Threshold: < 5 | Proxy Value: -2",     x = "Date",      y = "Reported Cases"   )

title: Small Number Suppression
text: bar charts, changing shape isn’t option. Instead, geom_col_suppressed() automatically maps suppression flag alpha (transparency) aesthetic. pair scale_alpha_suppress() make suppressed bars semi-transparent.
code: ggplot(overdoses, aes(x = month_date, y = count, fill = county)) +      # position = "dodge" places the county bars side-by-side   geom_col_suppressed(position = "dodge", color = "black") +       scale_fill_manual(     name = "County",     values = c("Salt Lake" = "navy", "Utah" = "darkorange")   ) +      # Custom ggsuppress scale for opaque/transparent bars   scale_alpha_suppress() +      theme_minimal() +   labs(     title = "Monthly Overdoses by County (Bars)",      x = "Date",      y = "Count"   )

title: Geometries for Small-Number Suppression — geom_suppress
text: mapping Set aesthetic mappings created aes(). data data displayed layer. position Position adjustment. ... arguments passed layer(). threshold Numeric. Values threshold suppressed. Defaults 11. proxy_value Numeric. y-value suppressed data plotted. Defaults 0. suppress_na Logical. mapping threshold proxy aes() allows NA values y pass substituted value proxy. subverts ggplot() default removal records containing NA. na.rm FALSE, default, missing values removed warning. TRUE, missing values silently removed. show.legend logical. layer included legends? NA, default, includes aesthetics mapped. FALSE never includes, TRUE always includes. can also named logical vector finely select aesthetics display. include legend keys levels, even data exists, use TRUE. NA, levels shown legend, unobserved levels omitted. inherit.aes FALSE, overrides default aesthetics, rather combining . useful helper functions define data aesthetics inherit behaviour default plot specification, e.g. annotation_borders().

Units Character. Analyte concentration units Ug/L ppb. Qualifier Character. Lab result flag. Non-detects <MDL flagged 'U'. MDL Numeric. Method detection limit analyte/method. RL Numeric.
